十月も終わり、今年の風炉のお点前もこれでおしまい。

十一月からは炉の季節が始まります。

炉開きの準備を進めながらも、風炉の前に座るのはまた来年かと思うと、やっぱり少し寂しい。

最後の薄茶は「鵜影」。
お菓子は「山苞（やまづと）」。

こなし生地の中には、秋の味覚、栗きんとんが隠れています。

茶杓で抹茶を入れ、湯を汲み、茶筅を振る。

いつもと変わらないお点前だけれど、今日は少し名残惜しく感じます。

また来年、風炉の季節に。

—

The Last Bowl of Tea | Furo Season

October is coming to an end, and this is my final tea practice with the furo this year.

November brings the ro, the sunken hearth used during the colder months.

I’m looking forward to the new season, but knowing that I won’t sit beside the furo again until next year makes me a little sad.

For this last bowl of usucha, I chose our matcha Ukage, accompanied by Yamazuto, a seasonal Japanese sweet with chestnut kurikinton hidden inside its soft konashi dough.

The familiar movements of preparing a bowl of matcha feel a little more precious today.

Until next year, furo.

十月も終わり、今年の風炉のお点前もこれでおしまい。

十一月からは炉の季節が始まります。

炉開きの準備を進めながらも、風炉の前に座るのはまた来年かと思うと、やっぱり少し寂しい。

最後の薄茶は「鵜影」。
お菓子は「山苞（やまづと）」。

こなし生地の中には、秋の味覚、栗きんとんが隠れています。

茶杓で抹茶を入れ、湯を汲み、茶筅を振る。

いつもと変わらないお点前だけれど、今日は少し名残惜しく感じます。

また来年、風炉の季節に。

—

The Last Bowl of Tea | Furo Season

October is coming to an end, and this is my final tea practice with the furo this year.

November brings the ro, the sunken hearth used during the colder months.

I’m looking forward to the new season, but knowing that I won’t sit beside the furo again until next year makes me a little sad.

For this last bowl of usucha, I chose our matcha Ukage, accompanied by Yamazuto, a seasonal Japanese sweet with chestnut kurikinton hidden inside its soft konashi dough.

The familiar movements of preparing a bowl of matcha feel a little more precious today.

Until next year, furo.

十月も終わり、今年の風炉のお点前もこれでおしまい。

十一月からは炉の季節が始まります。

炉開きの準備を進めながらも、風炉の前に座るのはまた来年かと思うと、やっぱり少し寂しい。

最後の薄茶は「鵜影」。
お菓子は「山苞（やまづと）」。

こなし生地の中には、秋の味覚、栗きんとんが隠れています。

茶杓で抹茶を入れ、湯を汲み、茶筅を振る。

いつもと変わらないお点前だけれど、今日は少し名残惜しく感じます。

また来年、風炉の季節に。

—

The Last Bowl of Tea | Furo Season

October is coming to an end, and this is my final tea practice with the furo this year.

November brings the ro, the sunken hearth used during the colder months.

I’m looking forward to the new season, but knowing that I won’t sit beside the furo again until next year makes me a little sad.

For this last bowl of usucha, I chose our matcha Ukage, accompanied by Yamazuto, a seasonal Japanese sweet with chestnut kurikinton hidden inside its soft konashi dough.

The familiar movements of preparing a bowl of matcha feel a little more precious today.

Until next year, furo.

炉開きの準備を進めながらも、風炉の前に座るのはまた来年かと思うと、やっぱり少し寂しい。

The Last Bowl of Tea | Furo Season

October is coming to an end, and this is my final tea practice with the furo this year.

November brings the ro, the sunken hearth used during the colder months.

I’m looking forward to the new season, but knowing that I won’t sit beside the furo again until next year makes me a little sad.

For this last bowl of usucha, I chose our matcha Ukage, accompanied by Yamazuto, a seasonal Japanese sweet with chestnut kurikinton hidden inside its soft konashi dough.

The familiar movements of preparing a bowl of matcha feel a little more precious today.

Until next year, furo.
